items.title: Is SoundHound AI in Play? The Acquisition Case for This Voice-AI Specialist
items.summary: SoundHound AI has built something rare in the voice-AI space: a platform that major automakers, restaurant chains, banks, and smart TV brands all depend on. Now, with shares down sharply and a transformative merger pending, several trillion-dollar companies have real reasons to consider writing a check.
